text:
maria_ops: FYI infra-cluster CI is failing on `apply` repeatedly. Runs sit queued by the `infra-apply` concurrency group then eventually fail with a terraform provider checksum error. anyone else?

gha-bot: Workflow infra/ops.yml #842 failed — job: apply (self-hosted) — exit code 1. See logs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-cluster/actions/runs/842

maria_ops: log snippet from the failing step: 
```
Initializing provider plugins...
- Finding hashicorp/google versions matching "~> 4.50"...
- Installing hashicorp/google v4.50.2...
Error: checksum mismatch for provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/google
  expected: h1:XYZ...
  got: h1:ABC...
```

kevin_infra: ugh. this smells like a stale plugin cache on our self-hosted runners. we cache `~/.terraform.d/plugin-cache` in the runner image, and if GH restored a cache with an older lockfile but a newer provider was pulled upstream, checksums can diverge.

jenna_sre: also seeing a backlog in the runner autoscaler — new runners take ~3-4m to join which makes queued jobs age out. combined with the concurrency group we get multiple queued applies that race to use the same cache snapshot.

samuel_platform: quick checks: 1) are we restoring a `~/.terraform.d/plugin-cache` from actions/cache? 2) does the repo have a `.terraform.lock.hcl` committed? if not, we should pin and commit a lock so restores are consistent.

maria_ops: repo *does* have `.terraform.lock.hcl` but looks like it was last regenerated in Feb 2024. provider got a hotfix in March that changed binaries+checksum. GH cache key uses `cache-terraform-plugins-${{ hashFiles('**/.terraform.lock.hcl') }}` — if the lockfile didn't update for some runs we can get mismatch.

kevin_infra: workaround: kick off a manual run on a clean ephemeral runner and run `terraform init -upgrade -reconfigure` to refresh the lockfile, then commit. I'll do that now, then we can re-enable concurrency.

jenna_sre: I'll bump autoscaler max nodes by +2 for the next 15 minutes so manual runs don't get throttled while we verify. watching cluster autoscaler logs.

gha-bot: Action started: Manual run triggered by kevin_infra (infra/ops.yml #843). Runner: ephemeral-ubuntu-22-01.

samuel_platform: long term we should: 
- bake runner image with an up-to-date plugin cache and add a CI step that verifies provider checksums against the lockfile before apply.
- change cache key to include runner-base-image-version (so AMI / image recreation invalidates cache)
- if possible use `terraform providers mirror` and a private plugin mirror for deterministic installs.

maria_ops: confirmed: manual run #843 completed `terraform init -upgrade` and updated `.terraform.lock.hcl`. I pushed the commit and re-ran the pipeline without the concurrency guard. Apply succeeded.

kevin_infra: note for postmortem: avoid having the concurrency group block cleanup runs. it prevented the clean/upgrade run from completing quickly. we'll add a short-lived bypass label for infra-owner runs.

jenna_sre: autoscaler note logged: scaling lag due to spot pool reallocation. filed infra-ticket: INF-721 (reduce spot dependency for infra-runners).

maria_ops: thanks all. I'll open a small PR to change cache key and add a pre-apply checksum verification step. close this thread once PR is merged. :thumbsup:
